subject.title: feat(backup): add exclude patterns, --smart-exclude, and protected path guards [ai]

question: Should native `backup create` accept this broad exclude contract, including default `.backupignore` auto-loading and currently deferred external-asset semantics?
rationale: The branch adds public CLI behavior and a backup security boundary where silent omission or inclusion changes restoreability and sensitive-data handling, so maintainer intent is needed before repair or merge.

options.title: Narrow and repair before merge
options.body: Keep native excludes but require explicit opt-in for file loading, apply patterns per asset root, and remove the order and large-archive regressions before review can pass.

options.title: Accept broad contract intentionally
options.body: Maintainers can approve implicit `.backupignore` and external-asset warning semantics, but should document the upgrade behavior and supply targeted proof before merge.

options.title: Pause for a fresh design
options.body: Close or pause this branch and keep issue 40786 as the canonical design target if the current surface is too broad to salvage.

recommendation.title: Narrow and repair before merge
recommendation.body: Keep native excludes but require explicit opt-in for file loading, apply patterns per asset root, and remove the order and large-archive regressions before review can pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original backup CLI PR and are the best history-backed owner for the backup CLI compatibility contract decision.
